description: This file contains utility functions for handling DOM events within the Leaflet mapping library, including event registration, removal, propagation control, and event normalization.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds event listeners to a DOM element for specified event types, supporting multiple types and event maps.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes event listeners from a DOM element for specified event types, supporting multiple types and event maps.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops event propagation to parent elements.

methods.name: disableScrollPropagation
methods.description: Prevents scroll events from propagating beyond the specified element.

methods.name: disableClickPropagation
methods.description: Prevents click and related events from propagating beyond the specified element.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents the default action associated with a DOM event.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Prevents default action and stops propagation of a DOM event.

methods.name: getMousePosition
methods.description: Returns normalized mouse position relative to a container or the page.

methods.name: getWheelDelta
methods.description: Returns normalized wheel delta in pixels from a mouse wheel event.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Alias for 'on' function to add event listeners.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Alias for 'off' function to remove event listeners.

search-terms: pointer and double tap event listeners
